start: Owner signed in on a laptop and a phone, Crispy Curves

steps.action: On the laptop add a member and sell a plan
must_not: A record lost on the way

steps.action: Open the admin app on the phone
must_not: The phone saving its old copy over the laptop's

start: Owner signs in on a new device

user_sees: Every member, plan, receipt, check-in, enquiry and expense of the gym
A line saying who pulled the whole copy, from where
must_not: No line for the whole-copy pull

start: Owner's device saves while another device saved first

user_sees: The change kept, put on top of the other device's work after a re-pull

steps.action: Save a record over 20 KB or 1,001 records at once

start: Owner's device, a save whose answer was lost

steps.action: The device sends the same save again with the same id
user_sees: The same version back; one copy of each record
The check-in gone on every device after their next pull
must_not: The taken-back check-in still shown elsewhere

start: Owner asks who can see the gym's records

user_sees: Only totals, unless the owner opens a support window
must_not: A member's name or number seen by MettleUp without a window

user_sees: Every whole-copy pull with the person and place

start: Front desk signed in on the desk PC; owner on a phone

steps.action: Check a member in at the desk

start: Front desk, an old panel offers to add an expense

must_not: The refused save sent again on every sync

start: Front desk, a check-in made by mistake

must_not: A member or receipt deleted by the front desk

start: Front desk signs in on a new device

user_sees: The gym's records needed at the desk
must_not: unknown: the whole copy (expenses and every receipt) reaches the desk device; no rule says the desk may not see expenses

start: Trainer signed in (a front-desk sign-in ticked as trainer)

steps.action: Make a workout plan and send it to two members
user_sees: The plan saved with the trainer's name as maker

must_not: The plan sent to members not picked

steps.action: Try to change a plan's price

start: Trainer, a workout plan already sent

must_not: The plan deleted from the gym's records
Members still seeing it after their next load

start: Trainer signs in on their phone

user_sees: The members and plans needed for training
must_not: unknown: the whole gym copy, with expenses and every receipt, reaches the trainer's phone
